about_the_game:
Make The Dead Dead Again is a third-person single-player shooter with deep customisation.

Lux's DNA has been enhanced by the shadowy government agency The Redaction Commission, and she's detected a glitch indicating that her missing mother Tess is still alive. Using her enhanced DNA and gun skills, she sets out in search of Tess, dealing with the Commission's legion of reanimated undead along the way.

Features:

  • Travel across multiple diverse environments searching for clues to find Lux’s mother

  • Defeat paranormal enemies using Lux’s gun skills and devastating DNA attacks: Smite, Shiver, Shockwave and Swarm

  • Utilise Lux’s unique DNA enhancements for both defence and attack, including Time Dilation, Dash and Enhanced Optics

  • Hundreds of customisation items to loot and unlock, including clothing, hair styles, dyes, makeup, tattoos and more. Use the Dressing Room and Style Studio to equip and customise Lux.

  • Customise Lux's Lair - her home base - by purchasing furniture and other items using in-game currency looted from dead enemies

  • Activate the wave spawner in The Lair to unleash waves of loot-laden enemies

  • Dance in the nightclub to earn Looties which can be used in Lucky Loom machines to unlock clothing and customisation prizes

  • As she levels up, Lux’s DNA enhancements become more powerful

  • Upgrade weapon attributes using weapon parts looted from dead enemies

  • Survive enemy ambushes while looting supply crates for generous rewards 

  • Tons of collectibles to find: unlock special rewards for finding complete sets

  • Explore, loot, level up and defeat the paranormal: make the dead dead again!

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560X or Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: In this third-person action-adventure, use Lux’s gun skills and enhanced DNA abilities to clear out enemies as she searches for her missing mother. Along the way, level up and acquire loot to equip her - and her home base - with an insane variety of customisation options.
